raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_transactions contains 28 txn_ids with two copies, distinguished only by record_version (1 vs 2) and a corrected amount, with identical batch and ingest metadata. The silver step keeps both copies, so the duplicates flow into silver and the gold aggregates. Keeping the highest record_version per txn_id before applying the POSTED filter should yield one correct row per transaction.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) latest WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED';"}}
